root_cause.text: The idle-skip optimization for exec queue suspend bypassed the GuC context-switch sequence required to flush TLB entries for invalidated userptr VMAs, causing missed TLB invalidation and potential page faults in LR/preempt-fence VM mode.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description states "The idle-skip optimization bypasses GuC suspend, so the GPU may not perform the context switch that flushes TLB entries for invalidated userptr VMAs. In LR/preempt-fence VM mode, this can lead to missed TLB invalidation and page faults during userptr invalidation tests." The diff removes all related code (xe_exec_queue_idle_skip_suspend, EXEC_QUEUE_STATE_IDLE_SKIP_SUSPEND, and associated logic).

candidates.rationale: This function defines the idle-skip condition, allowing suspend steps to be skipped for idle queues without considering the need for TLB flush via GuC context-switch.
Returns the idle-skip status flag used in suspend/resume paths to decide whether to bypass the GuC context-switch sequence.
Skips setting the ring tail when idle-skip is active, part of the bypass that omits needed GuC state updates for TLB flush.
This condition gates the normal suspend path (disable_scheduling) that includes GuC context-switch; when idle_skip_suspend is true, disable_scheduling is skipped.
In the suspend-pending branch, this sets the idle-skip flag, allowing the queue to be marked suspended without performing the GuC context-switch needed for TLB flush.
In the resume handler, this condition triggers a simplified resume that skips the full GuC context switch sequence, missing TLB invalidation for userptr VMAs.
Alternative resume path that calls sched_context without proper TLB flush handling, as the suspend was skipped and the GuC context-switch is not performed.
In LR mode, checks the idle-skip condition, leading to incorrect bypass of necessary GuC operations for TLB invalidation.
When idle_skip_suspend is true, need_resume remains false, skipping the resume that would ensure TLB entries are flushed via GuC context-switch.
Calls the suspend operation, which for idle-skip queues results in the backend skipping the GuC context-switch required to flush TLB for invalidated userptr VMAs.
